snippet.title: Developer Walkthrough: Welcome to Kilcairn
snippet.description:
🗝️ Enter the Shadows on 20th May: https://bit.ly/ThickAsThievesMB

Discord: https://discord.gg/cBqnatMYdA
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@playthickasthieves
Twitter: https://x.com/playtatgame

Enjoy this introduction to the world of Thick as Thieves in this Developer Walkthrough voiced by Game Director, Jeff Hickman!

From the creators of Deus Ex® and Thief®, Thick as Thieves is a stealth-action heist game built for solo play and co-op, where quick, replayable missions demand precision and nerve. Slip past guards, cut the lights, and vanish before anyone knows you were there.

🏴‍☠️ Play solo or team up for co-op heists
🕶️ Master unique thief abilities and playstyles
🔄 Dynamic missions with shifting guards and layouts
💼 Use gadgets like Smoke Bombs and Slithersap to outsmart security

Set in the shadow-draped city of Kilcairn, where magic meets early tech, no two heists play out the same. Adapt, improvise, and take what’s yours—before someone else does.

#ThickAsThieves #TripleIShowcase #IndieGames #Stealth #CoopGaming
